The '''Verdant Valley''' was a valley located on [[Nathema]]. It was the site of an ancient [[Ancient Temple|Sith temple]] used by [[Tenebrae]] to [[Emperor's Vaults|store]] the [[Zildrog]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. Like the rest of Nathema, the valley was devastated by Tenebrae's [[Ritual of Nathema|dark ritual]]. However, it was one of the first area of the planet to experience return of natural life after the death of Tenebrae.<ref name="TOR:TNC" />
